scope: independent root audit of the globally visible ordinary-j2 Cartier coefficient, its fixed-ray concentration, and the fixed-target dichotomy

mathematical_audit.global_coefficient: A_m=sum_(j=0)^m 8^(m-j)binom(2j,j) and 8^m c_p=8^m-epsilon A_m modulo p on every actual row
mathematical_audit.ray_classes: for fixed m, the two signs occupy exact residue classes modulo 8: 7 and 3 when m is even, 1 and 5 when m is odd
mathematical_audit.positive_mass: the prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions gives Chebyshev mass X/4 on each fixed sign/ray class
mathematical_audit.fixed_target: for a fixed rational target u/v, the condition is p|v(8^m-epsilon A_m)-u8^m; unless that numerator vanishes identically, only finitely many primes occur
mathematical_audit.counterexample: at m=0, c_p is identically 0 on one full residue progression and 2 on the other, so coefficient-only fixed-target nonconcentration cannot solve the moving target problem
mathematical_audit.scope_warning: the actual target 1-epsilon Theta_(r,s) moves and remains coupled to the determinant gate; neither its weighted density nor degenerate charts are controlled

PROVED: fixed-ray residue classification and positive Chebyshev mass
EXACT_FINITE_ONLY: canonical replay and enlarged root stress rows
OPEN: weighted zero density for the moving affine target after the determinant gate
target-retaining divisor localization or average gcd
degenerate connection charts and any capacity reduction
